title: Ephemeral calibration run lifecycle: auto-expiry, rollback, and temporary artifact promotion
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Problem: teams run ad-hoc calibration sweeps (FP8/INT8) for experimental quant profiles. These ephemeral runs create artifacts (calibration traces, quant profiles, evaluation snapshots) that are useful for a short time but clutter artifact storage, complicate permissioning, and pose a risk if promoted unintentionally. Goal: provide a first-class ephemeral-run lifecycle in the Console that creates time-bound artifacts, supports safe one-click promotion to durable artifacts with audit trails, and enables automatic rollback of model routing to previously promoted profiles if a promoted profile fails QA.
acceptance_criteria: Console can start a calibration run with an 'ephemeral' flag and optional TTL (default 7 days)
All artifacts from ephemeral runs are labeled in metadata as ephemeral and inherit TTL and owner team
Artifacts expire automatically after TTL: deleted or moved to cold storage per workspace policy; deletion is logged
UI shows clear badge and countdown for ephemeral runs and prevents accidental promotion without confirmation
One-click promotion flow that converts ephemeral artifacts to persistent artifacts with required approvals and creates an immutable promotion record
Rollback flow: if a promoted profile is rolled back within the SLA window, routing reverts and a rollback audit entry is created; metrics/alerts trigger when rollback occurs
RBAC: only users with 'calibration-promote' permission can promote ephemeral artifacts; 'calibration-view' can view and request promotion
